title: 📋 Data Integrity — Truncated Text, Empty Gun Notes, Synergy Name Fix
items: 📋 FIX (BUG-056): Briefcase of Cash effect text was truncated — 'Grants 250 and 3 .' restored to 'Grants 250 coins and 3 Hegemony Credits.'

📋 FIX (BUG-057): 12 guns with empty notes fields populated with wiki-sourced descriptions — AK-47, Derringer, M1911, Machine Pistol, Magnum, Makarov, Regular Shotgun, Thompson Sub-Machinegun, Trank Gun, Void Marshal, Vulcan Cannon, Winchester Rifle.
📋 FIX (BUG-058): Synergy name 'Thermal Imaging' corrected to official wiki name 'Thermal Imagine'.

title: ♿ Accessibility + UX Polish — Tap Targets, Tooltips, Haptics
items: ♿ FIX (BUG-051): 3 IconButtons with sub-minimum tap targets fixed — delete session (16px→44px), MP diagnostics close (20px→44px), favorite toggle (36px→44px). All now meet Material Design minimum.
♿ FIX (BUG-052): 21 IconButtons across 11 files now have tooltips for screen reader accessibility. Covers all dashboard +/- buttons, close/back buttons, search clear, favorite toggle.
🔧 FIX (BUG-053): 10 dashboard GestureDetector controls now call Haptics.light() on tap — Robot toggles, Junkan junk +/-, Gunderfury/Triple Gun/Evolver +/-. Consistent with compact_dashboards pattern.
🔧 FIX (BUG-054): Emote bottom sheet now uses useSafeArea: true — no more risk of system nav bar obscuring emote buttons on devices with tall nav bars.
🔧 FIX (BUG-055): Stats detail screen large stat value (fontSize 52) wrapped in FittedBox(scaleDown) — shrinks gracefully on narrow screens / high text scale settings.

title: 🔧 Synergy Icons + Dashboard Fixes + Gun Type Data
items: 🎨 FIX (BUG-022): All 395 synergies now have icons. 108 unique sprites + 287 using the generic blue synergy arrow as fallback. No more letter placeholders.
🔧 FIX (BUG-046): Junkan + 3 special gun dashboards (Gunderfury, Triple Gun, Evolver) — fixed inverted _expanded variable. Dashboards now start expanded and chevron points the correct way.

🔧 FIX (BUG-047): Robot dashboard — added 4 missing tracked fields: Armor counter, Fireplace Extinguished toggle, Battery Bullets Synergy toggle, Fuse Disarmer toggle. All were persisted in RunProvider but had no UI.
📋 FIX (BUG-048): Rad Gun — empty type field set to 'Semiautomatic'. Now shows type pill in browse and subtitle in detail.
📋 FIX (BUG-049): Gunderfury — garbage type field ('Semiautomatic Automatic Semiautomatic...') set to 'Variable'. Removed isGunderfury special case in gun_stats.dart.
📋 FIX (BUG-050): Deck4rd + Mr. Accretion Jr. — non-standard type variants normalized to 'Semiautomatic'.

title: 🧹 Code Hygiene — Dead Code + Silent Error Logging
items: 🧹 FIX: Removed 20+ dead '1S' quality normalisation branches across 9 files — the data no longer contains '1S' values (fixed in BUG-020), so these defensive branches were dead code in run_provider, gun, item, quality_badge, periodic_tile, browse_pills, game_icon, inventory_list_row, and sort_picker.

🔧 FIX (BUG-032): All 42 silent `catch (_) {}` error swallows now log errors via debugPrint with file-specific tags. Persistence failures (SharedPreferences disk-full, permissions) are no longer invisible — they appear in debug console across run_provider, app_theme, multiplayer_lobby, and 5 other files.
📋 FIX: Version desync corrected — pubspec.yaml bumped from 1.9.5 to 1.9.8+85 to match changelog entries v1.9.6–v1.9.8. All version strings in main_menu updated.

title: 🎨 Theme Palette Assessment Fixes
items: 🎨 FIX: Oubliette primary (#39FF14) and headline (#CCFF00) were identical to Bullet Hell — changed to sickly sewer green (#64DD17) and pale toxic lime (#B2FF59) for distinct identity. (Hidden theme — code quality fix for if it's re-enabled.)
🎨 FIX: Cult of Gundead primary was harsh pure #FF0000 — softened to styled #FF1744 (Material red A400) to match the tuned quality of every other theme. (Hidden theme — code quality fix.)
🔮 FIX: Robot's Core particle default was brassCasings (brass shells — doesn't fit cyber aesthetic) — changed to cosmicStars (cyan/gold/white twinkling stars) to match the teal/green circuit identity.
🔥 FIX: Forge Master Ember (+12°) and Inferno (-12°) remixes were too subtle to distinguish — increased to +25° and -25°. Magma kept at +35° (amber/gold, still warm).

title: 🎨 Compact Theme Picker + Particle Visibility Fix
items: 🎨 REDESIGN: Theme picker massively compacted — full-screen immersive pages replaced with a compact horizontal swipeable card carousel (100px tall). Each card shows the theme's color swatches and name. Dot indicator replaces the old circle strip.
📋 Theme details (name, tagline, apply button) now fit in a single compact row below the carousel instead of taking the entire screen.

🔮 FIX: Particles now visible in theme picker — old immersive pages had opaque scaffold backgrounds that blocked the particle layer. New compact cards use semi-transparent backgrounds so particles show through from the ThemeOverlay behind.
🧹 Removed dead _DashboardPreview widget (no longer referenced after compaction).

title: 🌀 Portal Vortex Animation
items: 🌀 NEW: Home screen now features a looping portal vortex animation — a bright glow orbits in a circular path around the center, pulsing brighter at the top and bottom of its orbit. Deep purple radial gradient background with faint vortex rings and a comet-like particle trail behind the glow. 14-second cycle, custom-painted, purely decorative.
💾 New 'last_played_character' persistence — survives run end and app kill, updates whenever you pick a character for SP or MP.

title: ⚙️ Settings Reorganization + Particle Studio + Menu Groups
items: ⚙️ NEW: Settings reorganized from 2 tabs to 3 logical tabs — APPEARANCE (theme, typography, glow, inventory layout), GAMEPLAY (dialogue, dice style, shrines, event log), APP (MP status, run session, inventory reset, changelog, dev tools, danger zone).

🎨 NEW: Particle Studio — all advanced particle controls (enable, count, size, opacity, glow effect, line links, edge bounce) now live inside an expandable panel in the theme picker. One place for all particle customization. Collapsed by default so the 3 quick strips (preset, color schema, speed) stay compact.
📋 NEW: Active run popup menu reorganized with labeled section headers — BROWSE, ACTIONS, SESSION, END, SETTINGS. The 12-item flat list is now scannable at a glance.
🧹 Removed particle section from Settings → Appearance (moved to theme picker Particle Studio).
🧹 Removed dice style from Settings → Appearance (moved to Settings → Gameplay).
🧹 Removed dialogue card from Settings → App (moved to Settings → Gameplay).
🧹 Cleaned up unused helper methods and imports from refactored tabs.

title: 📱 Responsive Polish — Final Pass
items: 📱 Browse screen tab bar — tab height, icon size now scale with screen width.
📱 Item detail screen — Back/Wiki/Action button sizes and font now scale with screen width.
📱 Multiplayer lobby — Start Hosting / Find Host button height scales with screen width.
📱 Settings theme visuals — all 4 action buttons (Choose Theme, Particle Preset, Glow Color, Font) height and font sizes scale with screen width. Theme label font scales too.
📱 Item detail header — item/gun name title font scales with screen width.
📱 Codex special page headers — all 6 special page title fonts (Paradox, Gunslinger, Bullet Hell, Drake, Challenge Mode, Rat) scale with screen width.
📱 Character select grid — column count adapts: 3 on <360dp, 4 on <500dp, 5 on 500dp+ (was fixed at 4).

title: 📱 Responsive Layout — Bigger Screens
items: 📱 NEW: Responsive scaling — all UI elements now scale proportionally to screen width. Baseline is 400dp (OnePlus 8). On wider screens (450dp+), buttons, fonts, tiles, and badges scale up up to 1.25x so they don't look tiny. On narrower screens, they scale down to 0.85x.

🔫 Periodic grid tiles — DPS/DMG/RNG badge font sizes, item name, and type subtitle now scale with screen width. Removed the textScaler clamp (0.8-1.05) that prevented fonts from growing on bigger screens.
🏠 Main menu buttons — Local Run and Multiplayer button heights, font sizes, and icon sizes now scale with screen width. Palette button and Changelog button also scale.
🎨 Theme picker — theme dot circles, theme name, tagline, flavour description, and Apply button all scale with screen width.
📋 Codex grid — column count now adapts: 3 columns on <360dp, 4 on <500dp, 6 on 500dp+ (was fixed at 4).

title: 🎨 Particle Customization + Codex Nav + Fixes
items: 🎨 NEW: 16 particle color schemas — Inferno, Glacier, Toxic, Void Storm, Gilded, Rainbow, Monochrome, Blood Moon, Synthwave, Forest, Candy, Steel, Sunset, Abyss, plus Preset Default and Theme Match. All work with every theme and palette. Selectable from the theme picker as a horizontal pill strip with mini color preview dots.
⚡ NEW: Particle speed control — 5 discrete steps from Very Slow (0.3x) to Very Fast (2.5x). Normal (1.0x) is the default. Selectable from the theme picker.
🔤 Megrim font moved to second position in font selection (right after Gungeon default).

🔧 CRITICAL FIX — MP particles: Entering a multiplayer run caused particles to disappear until app restart. Root cause: currentScreenIndex was set via addPostFrameCallback, leaving a stale frame where the home-screen galaxy + scrim painted over particles. Fix: set synchronously in build().

🔧 FIX — Codex special page scroll: All 6 special codex pages (Paradox, Gunslinger, Bullet Hell, Drake, Challenge Mode, Rat) wrapped their CustomScrollView in a nested Scaffold inside Expanded, blocking scroll. Scaffold wrapper removed — CustomScrollView now returns directly.
🔧 FIX — Codex nav strip: Compact 56px height (was 76), BouncingScrollPhysics with fast deceleration for smooth & quick horizontal scrolling. Tiles made more compact (icon 18px, font 11px).
🔫 FIX — Beam gun reload_time: 4 beam guns (Demon Head, Disintegrator, Gamma Ray, Raiden Coil) had reload_time '/A' instead of 'N/A'. All corrected.
🔫 FIX — Gun data: BSG damage prefixed with 'Impact:', range set to ∞. Composite Gun damage prefixed with 'Uncharged:', range set to ∞. Dark Marker range set to ∞, damage '40 x2' → '40x2'.

title: 🔥 BULLET HELL EDITION — Hotfix
items: 🔧 CRITICAL: Particles and glow were not showing on most themes — only 5 of 22 themes had particle defaults mapped. Bullet Hell, Lord Jammed, Resourceful Rat, and 14 others fell back to invisible dust. All 22 themes now have curated particle presets. Themes with glow colors also get a subtle auto-glow out of the box.

📊 Special dashboard panels no longer scroll — all panels now size to their full content height instead of being capped at 22% of screen. Robot's damage calculator terminal removed (took too much space with many guns).
📋 Codex categories now scroll horizontally as pill-style tiles instead of a cramped 4-column grid.
🔫 Periodic tile DMG/RANGE badges now split 50/50 — no more overflow on wider tiles.
🔤 Inventory Font Size slider moved next to global Font Size in the Typography settings section.
💕 MP Emotes — tap your own character tab in multiplayer to send a Kiss (6s floating heart) or Slap (2s screen shake) to the other player. Purely visual.
🐀 New Codex entry: The Resourceful Rat. 🐉 New Codex entry: The Drake. 🎲 New Codex entry: Challenge Mode.
🔥 Bullet Hell title on home screen is now bigger (18px) and wobbles in a fiery burst every 6s instead of continuously.

title: 🔥 BULLET HELL EDITION
items: 🔥 NEW: Bullet Hell codex page — a themed special page under the Codex tab with the official header graphic, presenting Chamber 6 lore, entry conditions, the 'No Loot' survival rules, the three-loop procedural layout, hazards, and the Lich's three-phase boss fight in a clean, scrollable dark-neon layout.

💥 Max Pane synergy fixed — now correctly activates when you hold both Glass Cannon and Glass Guon Stone. It was listed with only Glass Cannon in its items array, so the synergy never flagged active. Both items now required, as the effect text always implied.

🔗 Multiplayer reconnect now announces itself — a floating 'Connection restored — sync resumed' snackbar fires with a success haptic the moment the link comes back, instead of silently closing the drop dialog. Teardowns (disconnect/cancel) stay quiet so you only hear from it on a real recovery.

✨ Quality tier cleanup — 36 entries across guns (19) and items (17) were showing '1S' instead of 'S' in UI metadata chips, a data-pipeline artifact. All corrected to 'S'; the Browse quality-sort special case simplified.

🧹 Removed the Multiplayer Summary tab from the MP header — the P1/P2 header is now cleaner with just the two player tabs. The Summary page code is left dormant on disk for potential future re-introduction.

⚙️ Active-run gear menu restructured — 'Reset P1 Items' (and 'Reset P2 Items' in coop) now available as a quick action directly in the menu. Settings moved to the bottom so the top prioritizes in-run actions. The confirm dialog is now shared between the menu and the Settings Run tab.

🦄 Unicorn theme particles fixed — selecting the Unicorn theme now auto-enables unicorn sparkle particles with per-palette colors (cotton candy, neon, dreamy, sunset, bubblegum, mulberry each get their own particle color set). The palette selector no longer requires horizontal scrolling — all 6 palettes are visible in a wrap layout. ParticleField gained a colorsOverride param for per-palette color injection without bloating the preset enum.

🖤 S-tier quality badge reverted to its documented design — black pill, white letter, animated golden glow. The gold-pill drift (white-on-gold, low contrast) is gone. The S chest chip label and icon are now white instead of dark-on-dark, so 'Chest S' is actually readable.

🔫 Periodic grid gun tiles reworked — gun type (Pistol/Shotgun/Rifle/Beam/etc.) now sits as a centered subtitle below the item name instead of a tiny corner tag. RANGE is now shown alongside DPS in the bottom-center badge. Tile aspect ratio bumped from 0.80 to 0.75 to fit the new subtitle row.

⚙️ Settings merged — the old 3-tab Settings (VISUALS / RUN / APP) is now 2 tabs (VISUALS / RUN & APP). The Run & App tab uses a compact 2-column grid of icon+label action tiles grouped into RUN SESSION, INVENTORY & DATA, and DANGER ZONE. The dialogue card (haptics + text speed) stays full-width at the top. Old AppTab left dormant on disk.

📊 Stat-group tags upgraded — Combat / Handling / Meta labels in the gun detail screen are now bigger (15px, w800) and color-coded. Each group gets a signature accent color (Combat=red, Handling=cyan, Meta=amber by default) that themes can override to match their palette. Filled-pill header for filled-chip themes, accent-bar for minimalist themes. Stat pills in each group get a subtle label tint in the group color.

🎨 Theme + particle picking streamlined — every visible theme now auto-binds a curated particle preset (Forge Master→embers, Robot's Core→casings, Custom→cosmic stars) instead of only Unicorn getting particles. The theme picker has a quick-access strip of 5 tappable theme circles (no more swiping through all 5 full-screen pages) and a horizontal particle preset strip for instant effect switching. Applying a theme now returns you to where you launched from instead of kicking you to the home screen. A palette quick-launch button (pink icon) replaces the old Settings gear on the main menu top-right corner.

🔢 Periodic grid gun badges now show unit labels — DPS values display as '56.0 DMG' and range values as '1000 RNG' instead of bare numbers. Labels are smaller and dimmer than the values so the numbers stay the primary visual element.

🏷️ Active-run header icons now have text labels — the 4 toggle icons (Damage Calculator, Effects, Shrine, Special Panels) each show a tiny label below ('Calc', 'Effects', 'Shrine', 'Panels') so new users can tell what each icon does without tapping blindly. Labels match the icon color (amber when ON, dim when OFF).

✨ S-tier readability fixed on all backgrounds — S-tier quality pills, game icon rings, and chest chips now use gold accents (border, text, glow) instead of near-black, which was invisible on dark panels. The filled badge circle stays near-black with white text (matching the in-game S chest), but the surrounding chrome is gold so S-tier items and guns are clearly framed everywhere.

🔧 Bughunt fixes — missing mounted check in multiplayer lobby, deprecated withOpacity replaced with withValues, 8 dynamic GoopText widgets now have maxLines+overflow protection to prevent clipping on narrow screens.

🎨 Theme consistency pass — 22 hardcoded dark-grey card backgrounds across 14 files replaced with theme-derived AppTheme.flair.card so dialogs, cards, and panels now match the active theme palette (Unicorn pink, Forge warm, Frostbite blue, etc.) instead of clashing with a fixed grey.

👁️ Contrast fixes — 8 dim text colors (white24/white30/white38) on important content bumped to white54/white60/white70 for readability on dark panels. Affected: stat labels in tactical grid, evolver formula text, inactive spec names, fallback item letters, shrine USE button, no-results message.

🎭 Multiplayer lobby now theme-aware — guide titles, help icons, sidekick button, and session history icons use theme-derived colors (flair.primary/secondary) instead of hardcoded amber/pink/cyan. Semantic colors (ice=coolness, fire=curse) stay hardcoded as they represent game meaning.
📐 Main menu rebalanced — spacer flex reduced from 3+4 to 2+2 after mascot removal, bringing the action buttons closer to the Bullet Hell heading for a more balanced vertical layout.
💊 Browse pill padding standardized — all quality/coin/synergy/meta pills now use consistent 8x3 padding for a uniform visual rhythm.
🔍 Browse empty-search state — when a search yields no results in Guns, Items, or All tabs, a 'No results' message with a search-off icon appears instead of a blank screen.
👆 Browse add-button tap target enlarged — the + button in browse rows now has a 44x44 dp hit area (up from ~14px), making it much easier to tap on mobile while keeping the same visual size.
📳 Item detail haptic feedback — the remove, add, and favourite buttons in item detail now fire Haptics.selection()/light() on tap, matching the rest of the app.
🔕 Favourite toggle no longer clears other snackbars — removed the clearSnackBars() call so synergy-activated or other important snackbars stay visible when toggling a favourite.

🎲 New Codex entry: Challenge Mode — all 20 room modifiers and 4 boss-specific modifiers from the wiki, each with mechanics, exclusivity rules, and trivia. Accessible from the Codex grid as a new special page tile.

🐉 New Codex entry: The Drake — the secret Serpent/Baby Dragun companion. Full chain from Weird Egg hatching through Resourceful Rat boss fight to Advanced Dragun transformation. Includes lore, mechanics, rewards, Rat Keys, and trivia.

🖼️ Codex special page headers unified — all 5 special pages (Paradox, Gunslinger, Bullet Hell, Drake, Challenge) now have hero images with gradient scrims and consistent title sizing (28px, letterSpacing 3, height 200).

💕 MP Emotes — tap your own character tab in multiplayer to send a Kiss or Slap to the other player. Kiss: a pink heart floats up on their screen for 6s with your name. Slap: an angry face slams down and shakes their screen for 2s. Purely visual, no gameplay effect. Renders above all dialogs via root Overlay.

🐀 New Codex entry: The Resourceful Rat — the omnipresent thief, shortcut merchant, and secret boss. Covers stealing mechanics and the 2-room adjacency trick, the Bello-mask shortcut gun shop with quality/quantity by chamber, all 3 boss fight phases (throne → mech → Punch-Out!!), Rat Keys and reward room, the four Rat items (Elimentaler, Partially-Eaten Cheese, Resourceful Sack, Rat Boots), the Resourceful Indeed synergy, the Ring of the Resourceful Rat, and the Rat's full backstory. 6 sections, 24 info blocks.

📊 Special dashboard panels no longer scroll — all panels now size to their full content height instead of being capped at 22% of screen height. Robot's damage calculator terminal removed (took too much space with many guns); the +DMG% badge in the header still shows the boost.

title: ❤️ Huntress Health Stats Toggle
items: Huntress dashboard now has an ALL/HP toggle button next to the header label.
ALL mode shows the full pickup weight distribution (heart, key, shield, box, blank).
HP mode shows health-focused stats: heart drop chance per room, lost health without dog, heart weight, and rooms needed per heart drop.
Toggle uses animated container with filled/outlined heart icon for clear visual state.
Special Panels toggle icon changed to view_agenda (stacked panels) for better recognizability.

title: 🎨 UI Polish + Bug Fixes + New App Logo
items: Replaced app launcher icon with new GungeonMate logo across Android and iOS.
Item detail header: type (Active/Passive/Companion/gun type) and elemental effects now displayed as labeled chips below the quality rank badge.
Sell price metadata chip moved to last position after Synergies in item detail header.
Quality rank badge added to item detail header below the quote.
Fixed missing elements parameter in ItemDetailHeader call site (would crash on item detail open).
Fixed broken InkWell with empty child in Huntress dashboard (syntax error).
Settings gear moved to top-right corner of home screen; Changelog button centered at bottom and enlarged 15%.
Grid weapon/item icons scaled 15% bigger with circular borders removed for a cleaner look.
Gun type tags expanded for full readability in periodic tiles.
Merged coder/synergy-ui and coder/playwright-setup branches.

title: ⛩️ Shrine Picker UX
items: Added a USE button to each shrine row for one-tap activation.
Top-right shrines-used counter is now larger, tappable, and opens a popup log of used shrines with their effects and use counts.
Shrine activation sheet now emphasizes the main effect and breaks complex effects (especially Dice) into readable cards and bullet points.
End-active-run dialog is now larger (~15%) with bigger buttons, larger text, and a clearer warning icon.
Character picker gungeoneer art is now ~35% larger and bottom-aligned inside cards, filling the rectangular panel better.

title: ⬛ Minimalist Theme — Metallic White, Black & Grey
items: Added Minimalist theme: a stripped-back metallic interface of pure black, clean white, and cold grey with no glow and crisp information.
Minimalist includes five switchable palettes: Original, Graphite, Platinum, Charcoal, and Obsidian.
Minimalist is now the default theme for new installs and for users with no saved theme preference.
Theme picker shows Minimalist at the front of the visible themes list.

title: 🎲 Dice Roll UX: Cancel, Sparkles, and VS Overflow
items: Added MpDiceCancel protocol and cancel-challenge button for pending dice challenges, so challengers can withdraw before the peer accepts.
Sparkle particles now spawn at each die's exact on-screen position using per-die GlobalKeys and a particle-layer GlobalKey.
VS score row in the finished duel state uses FittedBox + overflow to prevent nickname/score clipping on narrow screens.
Minor curly-braces cleanup in multiplayer_session.dart to keep analyzer info warnings at zero.

title: 🏗️ Codebase Reorg: 5 Megafiles Split into 39 Widget Files
items: Active Run screen split — 9,520 lines → 566 lines across 15 widget files (player header, player page, dashboards, stat sheets, dice roll, summary tab, and more).
Item Detail screen split — 3,582 lines → 332 lines across 6 widget files (header, gun stats, item body, synergies section, destroy banner, quick jump).
Settings screen split — 2,390 lines → 64 lines across 6 widget files (theme visuals, run tab, app tab, swipe picker, run log, debug tab).
Theme Overlay split — 951 lines → 312 lines across 8 widget files (particles, backgrounds, easter eggs).
Browse screen split — 1,638 lines → 1,130 lines across 4 widget files (browse row, pills, toolbar, any entry).
Total: 17,891 lines → 2,404 lines across 39 new widget files. All dispose() and mounted checks preserved. Zero analysis issues.

title: Still Wallpaper Removal + Bughunt Cleanup
items: Removed still wallpaper system — 16 PNG wallpapers, WallpaperMode enum, kStillWallpapers, parallax motion setting, and _StillWallpaperBackground widget all removed. Home screen animated galaxy wallpaper retained.
Removed dead webview_flutter dependency from pubspec.yaml (was listed but never imported).
Comprehensive bughunt completed — 18 new bugs logged (BUG-017 through BUG-034) covering UX, UI/navigation, and data completeness issues.
Reorg plan updated with current file sizes — active_run_screen.dart grew to 391KB/9953 lines.

title: UI Polish: Detail View Redesign + Damage Calc Sizing
items: Item/Gun detail header redesigned — graphic centered with no inner border, title centered below, quote as plain italic text, rank shown as first metadata pill alongside sell price and synergy count.
Removed quality badge circle and type label from header row — rank now displayed as a colored pill in the centered metadata wrap.
Damage Calculator collapsed panel — increased padding, min-height, and font sizes for better readability.
Damage Calculator popup sheet — increased padding and header sizing for a more comfortable view.
Character select loadout view — taller cards, bigger in-game graphic, reduced padding for full content display.
Dashboard settings icon — fixed Spacer pushing icons off-screen in active run header.
Avatar cycling — fixed rectangular outline disappearing when switching to in-game GIF or animated card art.
Settings tab added to bottom navigation bar for discoverability.

title: 🚀 v1.7.0 — GOOPIAN LANGUAGE + CODEX BESTIARY + SETTINGS OVERHAUL
items: Goopian Language Mode — toggle between English and Goopian alien text; 600+ Text widgets across all 16 screens converted to animated GoopText translation.
Codex Bestiary — 146 enemies and 27 bosses added with icons, health values, and detail views sourced from wiki.gg.
Settings Reorganization — 4-tab layout (VISUALS, RUN, APP, DEBUG) with cleaner separation of concerns.
Character Select Rework — tap avatars to flip and preview, SELECT button to confirm; fixed loadout panel overflow.
Player Avatar Cycling — tap avatar on active run to cycle through static icon, in-game GIF, and animated card art.
Shrine Icon — tap opens Shrine Picker, long-press toggles shrine tracker panel.
Main Menu Polish — floating mascot with tilt parallax, idle float animation, compact settings gear icon, codex icon.
Performance — GoopText singleton refactor, dashboard AnimatedSize for smooth expand/collapse, wallpaper asset consolidation.
Refactor — removed procedural painters and hypnotic background system (-580 lines), consolidated 28 named WebPs into 10 curated wallpapers.

18 Special Dashboards — Robot, Huntress, Junkan, Gunderfury, Triple Gun, Evolver, Shellegun, Chamber Gun, Platinum Bullets, Iron Coin, Spice, Metronome, Sprun, Boxing Glove, Cigarettes, Polaris, Gunther, Gun Soul.
Damage Calculator — toggleable DPS terminal with per-gun breakdown and multiplier contributions.
Multiplayer — auto-reconnect, persisted sessions, FIX LINK, state-drift protection, dice decline protocol, snapshot backpressure, gift dedup.
UI Polish — collapsible sections everywhere (synergies, referenced-by, curse/coolness logs, saved sessions), fastRoute 150ms fade transitions on all navigation.

title: 🎨 UI POLISH — CHARACTER SELECT, SHRINE ICON, AVATAR CYCLING
items: Character select cards now require SELECT button press — tap avatars to flip and preview freely before confirming.
Character select cards fixed overflow when starting loadout panel expands (SingleChildScrollView + fixed image height).
Shrine icon on player dashboard now opens Shrine Picker screen on tap; long-press toggles the shrine tracker panel.
Player avatar on active run cycles through 3 graphics modes on tap: static icon → in-game GIF → animated card art.
Quick comment speech bubble wrapped in IgnorePointer to prevent intercepting taps on header icon buttons.
Settings gear icon added to main menu (compact, icon-only). Codex icon added to main menu bottom row.
Settings screen reorganized into 4 tabs: VISUALS, RUN, APP, DEBUG — cleaner separation of concerns.
New APP tab — Language toggle, Dialogue haptics & text speed, Custom Dice picker, Changelog viewer, Reset All App Data.
VISUALS tab expanded — Wallpaper section and Inventory Layout section now exposed.
Run Options popup menu refined — removed Guides & Info, My Favourites kept as top option, new Settings entry added.

title: ⏃⎎⎓⏁ GOOPIAN LANGUAGE MODE — FULL APP TRANSLATION
items: Language selection toggle added to main menu — switch between English and Goopian with a segmented pill toggle.
Full app Goopianization — 600+ Text widgets across all 16 screens and 10 widget files converted to GoopText for animated alien translation.
Sponge button polish — pulsing amber glow animation when translation is active, nuanced haptic feedback (success on activate, light on deactivate).
GoopText animation polish — snappier 500ms duration with easeOutExpo curve, reduced sponge delay from 1000ms to 800ms.
GoopText now supports softWrap parameter for full Text widget compatibility.
Language preference persists across app restarts via VisualPrefs.

title: ✨ MAIN MENU POLISH — FLOATING MASCOT + TILT PARALLAX
items: Mascot circle removed — The Tailor now floats freely with a subtle golden glow halo instead of a bordered circle container.
Tilt parallax added — Mascot responds to phone accelerometer movement with a gentle magical drift, creating an ocular subtle effect.
Idle float animation — Mascot gently bobs up and down with a 3.2s sine wave breathing animation, never sitting static.
Menu buttons refined — Slightly compacted height (56→54), refined font sizes, added subtle elevation shadow on Local Run button, haptic feedback on both button taps.
Button borders polished — Multiplayer button border opacity tuned for a more refined look.

title: 🦄 UNICORN PALETTE REDESIGN — 6 PINK/CRIMSON/PURPLE PALETTES
items: Unicorn palettes reduced from 7 to 6 — removed Rainbow (yellow accent), replaced Aurora (green) with Bubblegum (pink/magenta/violet), replaced Galaxy (blue/cyan) with Mulberry (deep magenta/purple/pink).
All 6 palettes now use exclusively pink, crimson, purple, and bubblegum tones — no green, blue, teal, or cyan accents remain.
Cotton Candy: rose pink accent replaces cyan. Neon: magenta-purple replaces electric teal. Dreamy: lilac replaces sage teal. Sunset: powder pink replaces golden teal.
Bubblegum: bright bubblegum pink + magenta + light violet — a playful pop-art palette.
Mulberry: deep magenta + purple + pink — a rich crimson-purple palette for the bold.

title: ✨ UI POLISH — COLLAPSIBLE SECTIONS + COMPACT SETTINGS

title: 🔁 MP RECONNECTION OVERHAUL: 10 BUG FIXES
items: PIN Code Persistence (CRITICAL): The MP session PIN is now saved to SharedPreferences and restored on app-kill recovery. Without this, the Main generated a new random PIN on restart and the Sidekick's endpoint filter silently rejected it — reconnection after app-kill was impossible.

RunState Restoration on App-Kill (CRITICAL): tryRestorePersistedSession now loads the full RunState (inventory, coolness, curse, shrines) from the most recent saved_mp_sessions entry, not just the role/character identity. Survives app-kill with zero data loss.

Sidekick Pre-MP State Persistence (HIGH): The Sidekick's pre-MP solo run snapshot is now persisted to disk and restored on app-kill recovery. Without this, cancel() after restore would overwrite the real pre-MP state with MP state.
Cancel Clears Reconnect Identity (CRITICAL): cancel() now clears _lastRole and _lastCharacter so canReconnect returns false. Prevents a PINless reconnect() call after cancel() zeroes the PIN.

State-Drift Protection During Disconnect (HIGH): Inventory mutations (addGun, removeGun, addItem, removeItem) are now blocked while MP is disconnected. Prevents local state drift that would overwrite the peer's correct state on reconnect.

FIX LINK Now Saves Before Reconnecting (MEDIUM): The FIX LINK button calls fullReconnectCycle() which saves the session to disk before restarting transport, guaranteeing a fresh restore point exists before teardown.
Connection Restored Popup (MEDIUM): A themed green SnackBar now appears when auto-reconnect succeeds, confirming the link is back so users don't have to guess.
Reconnect Attempt Count in Drop Dialog (MEDIUM): The connection-lost dialog now shows the live auto-retry attempt number so users know the system is actively trying.
Log NotifyListeners Debounced (MEDIUM): _log() now coalesces notifyListeners() calls via scheduleMicrotask, preventing 3-4 redundant UI rebuilds per auto-reconnect attempt.

MpError Triggers Auto-Reconnect (LOW): Transport errors (MpError events) now transition to disconnected state and start auto-reconnect, instead of leaving the session in a stale connected state with an error string.

title: 🧮 UNIVERSAL DAMAGE CALCULATOR + UI CONTRAST OVERHAUL
items: Universal Damage Calculator: Every Gungeoneer (not just Robot) can now see a live Damage Calculator terminal on their dashboard, summing quantifiable damage bonuses from equipped guns and items into a single DPS multiplier. Toggle it on/off in Settings → Run Utilities → Dashboard Display.

Tactical Stats Card Redesign: Removed the low-opacity ghost background icon on tactical-stats inventory cards (it was muddying the stat readout against busy wallpapers). Cards are now solid-backed with a crisp small icon next to the item/gun name.
Settings Screen Contrast Pass: Boosted background opacity across wallpaper pickers, font pickers, and utility panels in Settings so text and controls stay legible over any custom wallpaper.
Dashboard Header Contrast: Stat chips (Coolness, Curse, CD, Ammo, Synergies, DPS) on the active-run header now use a solid dark backing instead of a near-invisible 2-8% tint.

title: 🔧 BUG FIXES: BG, WALLPAPER & PARTICLE CLEANUP, MP RECONNECT
items: Background Disappears on Tap: Fixed a stale screen-index mutation in HomeScreen that caused the animated background to vanish when tapping anywhere after starting a new run.
Wobbling Sewer Jelly Wallpaper Removed: Removed the problematic animated wallpaper; users who had it selected are auto-migrated to a safe fallback.
Particle Systems Cleaned Up: Removed wind, gunpowder, and bullet particle types from the enum and rendering code. Persisted user settings are auto-migrated to prevent crashes.

Multiplayer Auto-Save & Reconnect: Added periodic session save every 20 seconds during MP sessions, immediate save on disconnect detection, and unlimited auto-reconnect retries with exponential backoff instead of entering a terminal error state on transient failures.
Version Labels Fixed: Corrected stale version labels (v0.9.994 and v2.3.0) on the home screen and changelog dialog to show the correct v1.0.1.

title: 🧸 NECKBEAR'S APPROVAL FOR ITEMS + SCRAPER FIXES
items: Neckbear's Approval Medal for Items: All 270 items are now checked field-by-field (type, chest color, sell price, recharge time, quality) against the official wiki and stamped with the bear medal 🐻 on both the Browse list and Item Detail screen. 268/270 passed clean; the remaining 2 (Drill, Duct Tape) have special non-numeric recharge conditions the wiki itself doesn't tabulate as plain text.

Legacy Wiki Page Support: The scraper (enrich_from_wikigg.py) previously only understood the newer 'druid-infobox' wiki layout and silently failed on ~140 items still using the older 'infoboxtable' format, leaving them uncached. Added a fallback parser for the legacy layout so every item's page is now readable.

Parenthetical Item Names Fixed: Items with disambiguation suffixes like 'C4 (Item)' were being looked up under the wrong cache filename and treated as missing. The lookup now strips the parenthetical suffix before fetching.

N/A Sell Price Detection: The wiki marks unsellable items with an image icon (alt="N/A") instead of text, which the scraper was missing entirely, leaving sell_price blank for items like Busted Television, Sponge, Trusty Lockpicks, and 8 others. Now correctly detected and filled in on both new-style and legacy-style wiki pages.

Data Cleanup: Fixed several corrupted fields found during the audit — bogus 'N damage' text stuck in recharge_time fields, a literal 'None' string incorrectly stored instead of an empty value, and specific sell_price/chest_color mismatches for C4, Ser Junkan 1, Spice, Boomerang, Orange, Ticket, Box, and Drill.

title: 🌍 ROOT-CAUSE FIX: EXIT-THE-GUNGEON DATA CONTAMINATION
items: Wiki Scraper Root Cause Fix: The wiki.gg infobox scraper (enrich_from_wikigg.py) was silently gluing Enter the Gungeon stats together with Exit the Gungeon (and other game-mode toggle) stats into a single string whenever a stat had multiple tabs on the wiki page. Fixed the parser to always extract ETG-only values, while carefully preserving legitimate in-game state toggles (like AC-15's Armored/Unarmored stats, which are both real ETG data).

22 Guns Repaired: A.W.P., AK-47, Alien Sidearm, Anvillain, Balloon Gun, Bee Hive, Big Iron, Big Shotgun, Blasphemy, Blunderbuss, Brick Breaker, Cold 45, Grenade Launcher, H4mmer, Jolter, Pitchfork, Regular Shotgun, and Void Core Assault Rifle had 78 corrupted fields (damage, fire rate, magazine size, ammo capacity, reload time, shot speed, range, force, spread, and type) silently mixing in Exit the Gungeon values — all now cleaned to Enter the Gungeon-only data.

Full Re-Verification: All 239 guns re-audited after the fix. 235/239 confirmed clean automatically; the remaining 4 are non-issues (wiki displays an infinity symbol instead of text for 3, and Heroine's charge-level labels were already correctly fixed in a prior update).

title: 🐻 NECKBEAR'S APPROVAL + CAT GONE + BG FIX
items: Cat Throne Overlay Removed: The secret Cat Bullet King Throne screen-peek widget is gone for good, no more surprise overlays.
Broken Still Wallpapers Fixed: Removed 28 phantom Still Wallpaper entries that pointed at image files which never existed on disk — Custom Still mode is hidden until real art ships.

Neckbear's Approval Medal: Every one of the 239 guns has been checked stat-by-stat against the official wiki and stamped with a cute bear medal 🐻 shown on both the Browse list and Gun Detail screen. All 239 passed — zero real mismatches found (3 wiki-tab parsing false-positives confirmed already correct from prior fixes).

title: 🐛 CAT THRONE WHITE SCREEN — ROOT CAUSE FOUND
items: Cat Bullet King Throne White Overlay Fix: The secret _CuriousCatStareWidget used a Positioned widget directly inside AnimatedBuilder (not a Stack), so its width/height constraints were ignored and the cat image was stretched to fill the entire screen as a semi-transparent white overlay. Now wrapped in a Stack so Positioned works correctly — the cat peeks from the bottom-right corner as intended.

title: 🐛 WHITE SCREEN FIX — SCAFFOLD TRANSPARENCY
items: White Opaque Screen Fix: Root cause identified as scaffoldBackgroundColor in AppTheme.themeFor() being 90% opaque when hypnoticBg was disabled. This obscured ThemeOverlay backgrounds (wallpapers, particles, galaxy) on any screen without explicit transparent Scaffold. Now always transparent — ThemeOverlay provides the base solid color via its own Container layer.

Full Screen Audit: All 10+ pushed screens (Multiplayer Lobby, Multiplayer Connect, Synergies Overview, Stats Detail, Shrine Picker, Item Detail, Favourites, Effects Summary, Character Select, HomeScreen loading/error states) now explicitly set backgroundColor: Colors.transparent on both Scaffold and AppBar.

title: 🐛 VISUAL POLISH — PARALLAX, OVERLAY, WIND ARTIFACTS, THEME BG
items: Smooth Parallax: Converted still wallpaper background to a StatefulWidget with AnimationController for buttery 60fps exponential lerp of gyroscope tilt values. No more sensor jitter or low FPS.

Quick Add Overlay Fix: Fixed race condition where a bright white overlay appeared when quick-adding items. Now uses FocusManager unfocus + PostFrameCallback to sequence modal dismissal before navigation.

Wind Path Artifacts Removed: Eliminated wobbly 'wind current' bezier curve rendering from all particle backdrops (Gold Dust, Hellfire, Cosmic Rift, Custom Particles). No more ghostly lines drifting upward.
Lingering Background Fix: ThemePickerScreen Scaffold was opaque (90% alpha), hiding ThemeOverlay backgrounds during preview and causing a flash when popping. Now transparent like all other screens.

title: 🤖 ROBOT TERMINAL + THEME OVERHAUL + 10 NEW THEMES
items: Robot Dashboard Redesign: Fixed font overflow on junk toggles. Gold Junk and Lies toggles are now bigger, more compact tap targets with icon + label + subtitle layout. DMG boost badge is now larger and more prominent.

Robot Damage Calculator Terminal: Added expandable retro green terminal showing per-gun damage calculations (weapon name, base DPS, robot-boosted DPS, and delta) with monospace styling and total DPS summary.

Theme Picker Redesign: Removed chip rows from theme preview cards. Replaced with per-theme custom preview data (stats, bullet notes) for all 21 themes. Added continuous weighted palette swatch bar showing BG/CRD/PRI/SEC/ACC with actual hex colors as fill.

Per-Theme Preview Data: All 21 themes now have custom stats, bullet notes, and subheadings that showcase their palette identity with real Gungeon flavor.

title: 🎨 UNICORN THEME FAMILY + HUD & EFFECT FIXES
items: Special Gun Panels Fix: Fixed substring matching bug where Ser Junkan, Gunderfury, and Triple Gun dashboards appeared for characters who don't possess those items. Now uses exact name matching (== 'ser junkan' instead of contains('ser junkan')).

Status Effects Rendering Fix: Replaced all 45+ 'Status Effects' lore ref tokens across items.json and guns.json with context-specific effect words (fire, poison, frozen, stun, stealth, charm, etc.). Effects like 'sets enemies on fire' and 'green bullets that poison enemies' now display correctly instead of showing a generic italic 'Status Effects' link.
Unicorn Theme: Removed twinkling star sparkle particles from the original Unicorn Bubblegum theme. The ambient pink/teal glow remains — just no more twinkling stars.

Unicorn III (Dream): New theme variation — softer whispered cotton candy with blush pink (#F8BBD0), sage teal (#80CBC4), and dusty lavender. Rounded 20px corners and gentle glow for a watercolour dream feel.

MP Auto-Reconnect Plan: Created comprehensive implementation plan for automated multiplayer save/reconnect system at docs/mp_auto_reconnect_plan.md.

items: Monster Blood: Fixed first wiki note to include Robot's 5-10 coin drop range.

title: 🔮 GLASSMORPHIC SETTINGS PANELS
items: Glassmorphic Settings Panels: Unified all settings screen panels (Typography, Inventory Grid, Particle Tuning, Switch Rows) and settings sheet dropdown/rows to use a consistent glassy aesthetic with flair.card at 35-38% alpha and themed primary borders. Panels now show the background through them subtly while remaining fully readable — no more nearly-invisible white-on-white containers.

title: ⚡ PARTICLE SYSTEM OVERHAUL, FPS FIX & PARALLAX REWORK
items: Elemental Particle Types: Completely reworked the custom particle type system to 7 distinct elemental types — Fire (embers & sparks), Water (bubbles & droplets), Earth (dust & stone pebbles), Air (wind gusts & streaks), Bullets (golden shells & brass casings), Gunpowder (smoke puffs & muzzle flash sparks), and Stars (cosmic sparkles with white cores). Removed all old emoji-based particles (necromantic skulls, skeletal bones, tombstone crosses, rainbow prismatic, frost, toxic, lightning, gold/brass/steel).

Massive FPS Optimization: Removed all expensive MaskFilter.blur calls from particle painters (curse fog, sparkles, hellfire, gold dust wind, cosmic rift wind). Replaced curse fog's blur(45) with cheap RadialGradient shaders. Replaced sparkle glow halos with cheap concentric alpha-gradient circles. Added RepaintBoundary to custom particle backdrop. Removed Gun_Fairy.webp async asset load that was wasting memory.

Particle Cutoff Fix: Removed all modulo wrapping (% size.height, % size.width) from particle position calculations across all 10+ backdrop painters. Particles now travel fully off-screen before fading out instead of wrapping around abruptly.

Parallax Rework for Large Screens: Increased accelerometer clamp range from ±6 to ±10 and smoothing factor from 0.12 to 0.18 for more responsive tilt. Still wallpaper parallax now scales by screen dimensions (screenSize.width * 0.015) instead of fixed 3.8px, so bigger phones get proportional movement. Lowered image filter quality to low for better FPS.

title: 🦄 UNICORN BUBBLEGUM REWORK & PARTICLE COUNT CONTROL
items: Unicorn Bubblegum Theme Visual Rework: Completely reworked the sparkle particle painter with a 6-color pastel palette (hot pink, lavender, mint cyan, soft pink, amethyst, white), dual-layer glow halos with MaskFilter blur, three distinct shape varieties (4-point star, glowing bubble, 6-point double-star), and bright white cores for a premium magical cotton-candy aesthetic.

Particle Count Now Affects Theme-Default Particles: Wired the user-controlled particle count slider to all 9 theme-default backdrop widgets (GoldDust, Sparkles, BrassMotes, IceCrystals, WhiteDust, ToxicBubbles, ForgeEmbers, Hellfire, CosmicRift). Previously these used hardcoded counts that ignored the user's density preference.
Live Particle Count Regeneration: Added didUpdateWidget to every theme-default backdrop widget so particle specs regenerate immediately when the count slider changes — no app restart needed.

title: 👾 RETRO GLITCH CINEMATIC BREACH & PROMPT HARMONIZATION
items: Dynamic 3D Retro Glitch Cinematic: Developed a cinematic intro system in glitch_intro.html with responsive Tailwind CSS, realistic camera forward POV corridor runs, and screen slamming transitions.

Analog Audio Sound Synthesis: Implemented Web Audio API sound generator to synthesize authentic retro glitch lasers, heavy bass impacts, and screen clicks without requiring extra media asset downloads.

Interactive Particle Exploser: Programmed a high-performance physical particle blast on canvas that triggers on screen slam, throwing dithered, outline-glowing block particles directly at the viewport with active bounce.

GungeonMate Live Replica: Rendered a stunning, high-fidelity dark-neon interactive mockup of GungeonMate's actual home layout with an active, drifting space galaxy and hover effects as the portal destination.

title: 🧹 THE GREAT UI CONDENSATION & GALAXY HOME SCREEN
items: Simplified Particle Options: Stripped the particle settings down to just Type and Density — completely removed sizing, emitters, rotation, gravity vortex, flicker, subtle mode, and touch sparkles for perfect, pre-tuned handcrafted excellence.

Swipe-to-Select Pickers: Replaced all dropdowns for Wallpaper Mode, Still/Animated Wallpaper selection, and Font Family with beautiful horizontal swipe pickers featuring live previews and animated scaling.

title: 🖼️ THE WALLPAPER & GYROSCOPIC PARALLAX ENGINE LAB
items: Exclusive Still Wallpapers: Bundled 19 gorgeous high-fidelity pixel-art scenes covering Gungeon chambers, weapons, and characters in assets/images/wallpapers/still/.
Gyroscopic Parallax Motion: Created a hardware-accelerated parallax engine that dynamically sways and offsets the background image based on the physical phone tilt accelerometer readings.
Animated Live Loops: Integrated a high-performance video player engine to play seamless 8-second looping MP4 backgrounds (vortex galaxy, weapons racks, sewer gelatin) with elegant fallback support.
Unified Settings Lab: Designed a dedicated 'Wallpaper & Parallax Engine Lab' section inside both Settings and the Premium Theme Picker to manage selections and toggles in perfect unison.

title: 🎨 THE INVENTORY DENSITY & LEGIBILITY CONTROL LAB
items: Flexible Inventory Grid Density: Added a customizable periodic grid column count setting in Style Lab and Settings, allowing users on standard/compact phones to seamlessly scale the inventory layout between 2 (compact), 3 (medium), or 4 (dense) columns.

Premium Subtle Particle Mode: Introduced an advanced legibility toggle that halves background particle counts across all custom presets and theme-specific backdrops, maximizing text readability in low-light environments without sacrificing the beautiful floating ambiance.
Integrated Style Lab Options: Consolidated all grid layout, periodic columns, and inventory text scaling options under a unified, beautiful 'Inventory Grid & Display Tuning' section.
Unified Customization Panels: Reorganized the full Vibe & Customization Tuning panels inside the Premium Theme Picker to stay perfectly in sync with the primary settings screens.

title: ⚙️ THE PREMIUM PARTICLE REDESIGN & GLOBAL GOOP CONVERSION
items: Categorized Particle Themes: Critically redesigned all background custom particles and grouped them into Elements (Ember, Frost, Toxic, Lightning, Rainbow), Metal (Golden Shells, Brass Casings, Steel Sparks), and Bone (Necrotic Skull, Skeletal Ashes, Tombstone Dust).
Dynamic Wind and 3D Z-Depth: Added flowing colored background wind paths and physical diagonal vector winds to all premium custom particles, and added Z-depth parallax scale factors.
Global GoopText Integration: Wrapped all Database Search row results, Item/Gun Detail titles, and Shrine Picker modal attributes in GoopText, so they convert dynamically to Goopian in perfect unison.
Consolidated Procedural Backgrounds: Removed raw static GIF options to exclusively use our ultra-clean, high-performance, GPU-accelerated animated procedural backdrops.

title: 📺 THE PROCEDURAL BACKGROUNDS & SPECIAL HUD REFACTOR UPDATE
items: Special Inventory HUDs: Gunderfury, Triple Gun, and Evolver are now fully rendered as separate, detailed dashboard panels right after the main player character DASH, just like Ser Junkan!
Procedural Animated Backgrounds: Introduced high-performance, real-time CRT Analog Static and Cyber Glitch Screen backdrops, painted entirely procedurally via hardware-accelerated canvas commands.
Central Dimming Readability Mask: Applied a deep radial gradient vignette over the center and corners of all animated backgrounds, ensuring that card text, labels, and icons remain 100% readable.
Settings Tooltip showDuration: Calibrated info-tooltip popups under the Style Lab Settings screen to stay visible for 5 full seconds instead of vanishing too quickly.

Dynamic Particle Gyro sways: Hooked up real-time accelerometer tilt forces to all default and custom particle systems, allowing floating stars, cat paws, and gunfairies to sway organically as you tilt your phone.

title: 🏹 THE PRE-RELEASE GENERAL UX & SYSTEM POLISH UPDATE
items: Polymorphic Theme Refactor: Moved all theme flair definitions directly into enum templates, removing thousands of lines of scattered switch-case blocks.

Redesigned Tactical Stats: Created wide double-column inventory cards showing a full 6-parameter stats spreadsheet on top of a giant blurred background gun/item icon, complete with active fire-mode/type tags.

Shrine Picker Upgrades: Cleanse shrine is now sorted to the absolute top of the list, activation sheet graphics are enlarged to a giant 120x120 size, and explicit 'Heart Container -1' penalty badges are displayed for Angel and Blood shrines.
App Appearance Compaction: Consolidated all font-tuning dropdowns and sliders into a single unified card in Settings with ultra-compact 32px slider track profiles.

Huntress HUD Slider: Implemented an information-dense sliding tab dashboard showing Junior II dog item drop weights (doubling to 10% if Baby Good Mimic is held), Crossbow HP breakpoints, and Oubliette/Abbey key economies.
Main Menu Aesthetics: Enlarged GungeonMate title outlines and ribbons on the main menu, and expanded our central Tailor mascot with 16 new highly detailed Gungeon-lore quotes.
Tactile ScaleButton Integration: Wrapped all primary main menu categories, the Tailor mascot, and Gunfortuna dice triggers in physical bouncy button scaling and automatic haptics.
Optimized Display Options: Permanently deleted wonky, unpolished views ('RPG Bag rows' and 'Gallery Display') and redundant tips menus to keep the app lean, fast, and optimized.

Goopian Language Mode: Added an immersive Goopian translation engine option in Settings. Activating it converts mascot dialogues and gun/item titles into Professor Goopton's unreadable cipher symbols.

The Sponge 🧽 Mode Toggle: Implemented a prominent, glowing interactive Sponge button in the Active Run app bar when Goopian is active. Tapping it magically runs a matrix-deciphering translation stream to reveal readable English text.

title: 🎯 THE ROAD TO 1.0: PRE-RELEASE CONSOLIDATION
items: Version Scheme Revamp: Reset and consolidated app versioning, laying the stable foundation for our official Play Store launch in July!
Premium Companion Features: Clean and highly optimized run tracking, synergies reference, dual-telemetry tactical stat grid layouts, and active co-op syncing.
Completely Free: GungeonMate is 100% free and open-source for all Enter the Gungeon fans to use, track, and master their runs.
Dynamic Stylization: Real-time theme picker previews, particle customizers, and physical hardware gyroscope sways are fully calibrated for maximum smoothness.
Optimized APK Build: Compiled a highly streamlined, high-performance production-ready release APK available for direct sideloading.
